occurrences.text: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.
Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
